abstract: We experienced a case of primary gastric choriocarcinoma(PGC)treated by curative operation after neoadjuvant chemotherapy with S-1/CDDP. Gastric endoscopy was carried out on this 43-year-old woman with epigastric discomfort and revealed an ulcerative lesion in her stomach. Choriocarcinoma in the gastric lesion was pathologically shown by endoscopic biopsy, so we diagnosed the patient without another primary lesion as PGC. The patient was initially treated by five courses of neoadjuvant chemotherapy with S-1/CDDP due to the metastases of Virchow and intraabdominal lymph nodes, and then a curative operation could be performed because of disappearance of the lymph node metastases by neoadjuvant chemotherapy. The patient was continuously treated by S-1 after gastrectomy but was dead due to the multiple metastases of the liver and adrenals, and the multiple recurrences of lymph nodes four months after the surgery. Further therapeutic strategy by chemotherapies against PGC is needed to ameliorate the prognosis.
abstract_ja: 我々は、S-1/CDDPによる術前化学療法後に根治切除を行った原発性胃絨毛癌(PGC)の症例を経験した。症例は心窩部不快感を主訴とする43歳の女性で、内視鏡検査で胃に潰瘍性病変を認めた。内視鏡生検で胃病変に絨毛癌が病理学的に確認され、他の原発巣がないためPGCと診断した。Virchowリンパ節および腹腔内リンパ節への転移が認められたため、まずS-1/CDDPによる術前化学療法を5コース施行した。化学療法によりリンパ節転移が消失したため、根治手術を施行できた。胃切除術後もS-1による治療を継続したが、術後4か月で肝臓および副腎の多発転移とリンパ節の多発再発により死亡した。PGCに対するさらなる化学療法の戦略が、予後改善のために必要である。
